title: DNA binding studies of antifungal drug posaconazole using spectroscopic and molecular docking methods.
authors: Madku, Shravya Rao; Sahoo, Bijaya Ketan; Lavanya, K; Reddy, Ragaiahgari Srinivas; Bodapati, Anna Tanuja Safala
one_liner_zh: 该文通过光谱实验和分子对接研究抗真菌药泊沙康唑与小牛胸腺DNA的小沟结合，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作体系中的小分子-DNA互作，方法含分子对接但非TF-DNA核心，可借鉴其对接与结合模式分析思路。
abstract: The binding studies of DNA with small molecules have been an emerging field of research all the time since DNA as the genetic material is a major biological target for various drugs. Interpretation of small molecule-DNA binding helps in understanding their interactions with designing new drugs of greater medicinal activity. Posaconazole is an antifungal drug in the class of triazoles which are known to possess numerous pharmacological properties. In this work, the nature of the binding of posaconazole with calf-thymus DNA has been studied using spectroscopic techniques and molecular docking studies. A binding constant of the order of 10(3) M(-1) was observed from UV-visible and fluorescence studies for the interaction between posaconazole and calf-thymus DNA. The fluorescence property of posaconazole was found to be quenched by calf-thymus DNA with a quenching constant of the order of 10(3) M(-1). Competitive displacement of ethidium bromide and Hoechst 33258 by posaconazole using fluorescence technique suggested minor groove binding of posaconazole in calf-thymus DNA. Confirmation of the binding mode was further complemented by the viscosity measurement and DNA melting studies followed by KI quenching experiments. The studies on the effect of ionic strength on the binding suggested a possible role of electrostatic force in the interaction. Molecular docking studies reflected a crescent shape of the posaconazole within the minor groove of calf-thymus DNA validating the experimental findings showing the residues involved in the interaction.
abstract_zh: DNA与小分子的结合研究一直是一个新兴的研究领域，因为DNA作为遗传物质是多种药物的主要生物靶点。解析小分子与DNA的结合有助于理解其相互作用，并设计具有更强药理活性的新药。泊沙康唑是一种三唑类抗真菌药物，已知具有多种药理特性。本研究采用光谱技术和分子对接研究，探讨了泊沙康唑与小牛胸腺DNA结合的性质。紫外-可见光谱和荧光研究观察到泊沙康唑与小牛胸腺DNA相互作用的结合常数约为10(3) M(-1)。发现泊沙康唑的荧光特性被小牛胸腺DNA猝灭，猝灭常数约为10(3) M(-1)。通过荧光技术进行的溴化乙锭和Hoechst 33258竞争性置换实验表明，泊沙康唑在小牛胸腺DNA中结合于小沟。结合模式的确认进一步通过粘度测量和DNA熔解研究以及KI猝灭实验得到补充。离子强度对结合影响的研究提示静电作用力可能在相互作用中发挥作用。分子对接研究显示泊沙康唑在小牛胸腺DNA小沟内呈月牙形，验证了实验发现并显示了参与相互作用的残基。
